properties: Scenario attaches the projected transport cause only when its source frames match the manifest-derived finite diagnostic pins. Existing outer best-effort failure-context capture retains the primary on a projection exception.

Parent remains stdlib-only. It reads the diagnostics file through the existing bounded stable read helper, verifies its exact admitted SHA, and parses only named finite literal registries via AST; no application import, exec or eval is performed.
Recursive registry interpretation is limited to depth8 and frozenset literals/named unions; all output strings are closed and bounded.
Terminal validates exact transport schema/category/stage/class/code and each frame path/hash against finite admitted source_pins before rendering.
Two new remaining_only checkpoint names are included; no owner/runtime integration or admission is issued by this inactive wrapper candidate.
required_controls: Actual projection chain from a pinned synthetic transport failure through scenario context to Terminal display.
Reject unpinned/tampered source-frame identity, nonregistry code/type/stage and incompatible terminal category.
Preserve the original primary even if optional context/readback/display fails.
review_scope: Additional scenario attachment and parent Terminal closed-registry/frame validation; remaining_only logic unchanged after prior source review.
